name: ctxline
description: ctxline statusline plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: ctxline-desktop
plugins.description: Statusline for the Claude desktop app: live activity, context, cache hit rate, 5-hour and weekly usage limits, cost and Git sync above the prompt. Learn more at ctxline.js.org

plugins.name: ctxline-desktop-themes
plugins.description: Four dark looks for the Claude desktop app, three in Claude orange (Dusk, Ember, Contour) and one in gold (Phoenix), each with a light version and an animated background. Switch with /ctxtheme. Learn more at ctxline.js.org
